name: BASMAH
mission: When you brighten a life, you ignite change that extends far beyond one person. Each individual touched goes on to inspire and uplift those around them, creating a ripple effect of hope and transformation. At BASMAH, we are committed to brightening as many lives as possible—because every life changed brings the world one step closer to a brighter future.
theoryOfChange: The right kind of change happens when people are empowered. Our vision is to empower people and enable them to help themselves and their communities. Short-term help is needed but long-term stability is the goal. Basmah Foundation doesn’t only bring relief to these people in need. We bring them a solution. Our projects are developed with hope of long-term growth for communities all over Bangladesh so they can become self-sufficient.
